reconcile.note: Gill reads Psalm 22's hiding of God's face as only for a moment, with the same psalm affirming the cry was heard, so hiding texts mean temporary withdrawal, not reliable absence.

sides.snippet: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
sides.verseText: > My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

sides.snippet: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
sides.verseText: > God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
